item.title: Canadian women’s hockey team beats Germany to reach Olympic semifinals
item.description: The Canadian women’s hockey team is off to the semifinals at the Winter Olympics after a 5-1 victory over Germany. Marie-Philip Poulin tied Hayley Wickenheiser as Canada’s all-time Olympic leading goal scorer after notching her 18th career marker in the third period. item.title: Surrey police investigating fatal pedestrian crash
item.description: The Surrey Police Service (SPS) says it is investigating after a fatal pedestrian collision in the city's Cedar Hills neighbourhood Friday evening.

item.title: Canada and Germany sign declaration of intent to grow AI field together
item.description: OTTAWA — Canada and Germany have signed a joint declaration of intent to work together on growing the field of artificial intelligence. The signing also coincides with the launch of a Sovereign Technology Alliance between the two countries. A statement says the declaration of intent allows the two countries to focus on expanding AI research […]

item.title: US, Iran to hold new round of nuclear talks in Geneva this week, Swiss government says
item.description: GENEVA (AP) — Iran and the United States will hold a second round of talks over Tehran’s nuclear program next week, the Swiss Foreign Ministry said Saturday. item.title: Hazmat team called to Vancouver mall due to sewer odour
item.description: Several Hazmat Response Team vehicles were called to Kingsgate Mall in Vancouver Saturday afternoon for what turned out to be odour from a sewer.

item.title: Young Vancouver Island musician sending love to Tumbler Ridge through song
